name: Dragon Horn
review:
Dragon Horn is a 243-ways fantasy slot with knights, elves and orcs. A wild, a Dragon Fire symbol and a scatter-triggered bonus are its features.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with an 8,282x cap and a 96.1% RTP.

The Dragon Fire symbol is the key to the base game, and the scatter bonus is where the larger wins live. It's an older Thunderkick title with a classic fantasy look and simple rules.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
